confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Hong Kong prices; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Meal and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and season. Beer is the least certain because Hong Kong has few domestic brands, so this reflects a typical local draft price. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly rather than from the beer relationship. The FX rate is the RBA figure for 2026-10-15 as reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; I could not open the live page to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used; anchors reflect Hong Kong's own urban price level for a July 2026 window.
